concept: Весёлое семейное пиратское кино: охота за сокровищами от карты с крестиком до найденного сундука — подзорная труба, попугай, компас, лопата, штурвал, якорь, остров, сундук и пиратский корабль. Без оружия, черепов и страшного.
style_mood: Mood: a funny, sunny family pirate adventure movie; the objects look like classic pirate-film treasure-hunt props and ship gear: warm wood, brass, gold and canvas, charming and slightly chunky but believable, never toy-like; cheerful and friendly, never scary; no skulls, no bones, no swords, no cannons, no guns, no people.
palette_note: Pirates: морская палитра фонов — небесно-голубой, кобальт, океанский синий, фиолетовый/лавандовый — под тёплыми объектами (дерево, латунь, золото, красный); 3 тёплых/зелёных акцента (пыльно-розовый, персиковый, янтарный) под зелёным попугаем и синими объектами; сундук — красный на зелёных джунглях.

cards.label: X Marks
cards.object: old treasure map with curled rolled-up edges
cards.scene: treasure map floating in the air
cards.key_features: a simple island outline drawn in brown ink, a dotted trail leading to a big bold red X, both short edges curled into rolls; no letters, no numbers, no writing
cards.pose: The map is tilted diagonally, the upper-right corner slightly curled toward the viewer, the red X clearly visible

cards.label: Land Ho!
cards.object: extended pirate spyglass telescope with three sliding sections
cards.key_features: three telescoping brass tubes of decreasing width, a wide glass lens at the big end, a narrow eyepiece at the small end, a red leather grip on the widest tube
cards.pose: The spyglass lies diagonally from lower left to upper right, the wide lens end at the upper right

cards.label: Squawk!
cards.object: pirate parrot perched on a wooden T-shaped perch stand
cards.scene: parrot sitting on a perch stand on a plain floor
cards.story_detail: a round cracker held in its beak
cards.key_features: a red forehead and yellow wing tips, a classic parrot silhouette with a curved hooked beak and a long tail, sitting calmly on a simple wooden T-perch; a real bird, no costume, no hat, no eye patch
cards.pose: 3/4 view at eye level, the parrot turned slightly toward the viewer, the tail hanging down behind the perch

cards.label: True North
cards.object: old brass ship's compass with its hinged lid open
cards.surface: old sea chart spread on a wooden table
cards.scene: compass lying on a sea chart on a wooden table
cards.key_features: a round brass case with an open hinged lid, a red-and-white needle over a simple star-shaped compass rose; no letters on the dial
cards.pose: The open lid stands behind the dial, the needle pointing to the upper right

cards.label: Dig Here
cards.object: wooden spade stuck upright in the sand
cards.scene: spade stuck in the beach sand
cards.story_detail: a big X drawn in the sand right in front of it
cards.key_features: a long straight wooden handle with a D-shaped grip on top, a pointed spade blade pushed halfway into the sand
cards.pose: 3/4 view at eye level, the spade leaning slightly to the right, the X in the sand in the foreground

cards.label: Ship's Wheel
cards.object: wooden ship's steering wheel with eight spoke handles, mounted on a short wooden post
cards.scene: ship's wheel on a post on a plain floor
cards.key_features: a round wooden rim with eight turned spoke handles sticking out beyond it, a shiny amber-brass center hub
cards.pose: 3/4 view slightly from below, the wheel turned a little toward the viewer so it reads as a circle

cards.label: Drop Anchor
cards.story_detail: a thick rope coiled through the top ring
cards.key_features: a straight shank with a crossbar stock near the top ring, two curved arms ending in pointed flukes
cards.pose: The anchor is tilted diagonally, the curved arms at the lower left and the ring with the rope at the upper right

cards.label: Treasure Isle
cards.object: tiny round tropical island with one leaning palm tree
cards.scene: a small sandy island in the middle of a calm deep ocean-blue sea, a ring of light shallow water around it, a single small rock at its edge
cards.story_detail: a big X marked on the sand
cards.key_features: one tall fresh green palm tree leaning to the side with a big green crown and a few coconuts, a small round hill of golden sand, the red X on the sand clearly visible
cards.camera: camera slightly above the water level, 3/4 view looking a little down so the top of the island and the X are visible
cards.pose: The island fills the center, the palm tree leaning to the upper right

cards.label: Found It!
cards.object: wooden treasure chest with its lid open, overflowing with gold coins
cards.scene: a sunny tropical jungle clearing with big green leaves around, the chest sitting in a freshly dug hole in golden sand
cards.story_detail: a string of white pearls hanging over the front edge
cards.key_features: a classic domed lid swung open, amber gold brass corner bands and a brass lock plate, a heap of shiny gold coins spilling over the rim
cards.camera: camera slightly above, about 30 degrees, close to the chest so the gold inside is clearly visible
cards.pose: 3/4 view, the open chest in the foreground, the lid open toward the back

cards.label: Set Sail
cards.background_color: bright blue sky over the sea
cards.scene: the galleon sailing on a bright turquoise-blue sea with small friendly waves
cards.story_detail: a big square patch sewn on the main sail
cards.key_features: a rounded wooden hull with a raised stern, three masts with billowing creamy white sails, a small dark navy flag on top with a white cartoon parrot emblem instead of a skull
cards.pose: The bow comes toward the viewer at 3/4, sails full of wind
